q1_issues.issue: "a decision on the case" is a noun-attached about-PP, which the instruction set explicitly excludes from Theme and Patient, and this also puts a thematic role atom — whose form is (<Role> <event> <filler>) — on the non-event entity sk_decision_1.

q2_gaps: noun-attached PP modifier / about-phrase ("a decision on the case"): the instruction set rules the about-phrase out of the possessive mapping and shows only entity-attached "from" keeping its surface preposition, but states no general form for such a PP

light / support-verb construction ("makes a decision"): the light-verb rule covers only occurred / happened / took place over an event noun, and only for attaching tense and Time, so nothing says whether this stays a make event over a decision entity or reifies one decide eventuality
notes: Patient on "a decision" is right — make creates its object — and the surface make lemma is correctly kept rather than normalized to decide. Definite "the case" as a typed individual and the absent status atom on the bare simple present are also correct.
